CARBON-TI(카본티)는 이름 그대로 카본(Carbon)과 티타늄(T: CARBON-TI is an Italian bicycle component brand that, as the name says, works in carbon and titanium. By combining the strengths of different materials in a single part, it takes weight out and adds stiffness and durability wherever a component spins, brakes or holds.
체인링과 디스크 로터처럼 라이더가 가장 민감하게 느끼는 구동계와 제동계부: From the drivetrain and brakes that riders feel most, like chainrings and disc rotors, to thru axles, headset caps and a single bolt. CARBON-TI believes the difference in material and machining shows even in the smallest part.
이탈리아에서 설계하고 가공하는 컴포넌트: Components designed and machined in Italy

규격, 톱수, 컬러별로 운영하는 국내 품목: Items stocked in Korea by spec, tooth count and colour
체인링의 바디와 로터의 캐리어를 카본으로 만들어, 강성이 필요한 곳은 단: Chainring bodies and rotor carriers are carbon, keeping stiffness where it is needed and cutting rotating mass.
체인이 물리는 톱니, 패드가 닿는 제동면, 힘을 받는 볼트. 마찰과 하중: The teeth the chain engages, the surface the pads grip, the bolts that take the load. Metal goes only where friction and load demand it.
스루액슬, 행어, 볼트는 CNC로 가공합니다. 피치와 길이, 규격을 세분: Thru axles, hangers and bolts are CNC machined, with pitch, length and fitment broken down to match each frame and drivetrain exactly.

made in carbon.
X-CARBORING은 체인링의 바디를 카본으로, 체인이 물리는 톱니를: X-CARBORING pairs a carbon chainring body with metal teeth where the chain engages. It lightens the largest, heaviest part of the crank while keeping the stiffness that shifting and power transfer need.
아우터용 EVO, 1x 구동계용 X-SINGLECARBON, 듀라에이스: EVO for outer rings, X-SINGLECARBON for 1x drivetrains and X-AERORING for Dura-Ace 9200. Pick the crank fitment and tooth count to match your drivetrain.
2x 구동계용 카본 체인링입니다. 이너는 X-CARBORING, 아우터는: Carbon chainrings for 2x drivetrains. X-CARBORING for the inner, EVO for the outer, with a dedicated Shimano FC-R9200 outer and an X-AXS range for SRAM AXS.
X-SINGLECARBON은 1x 로드와 그래블을 위한 싱글 카본 체인링: X-SINGLECARBON is a single carbon chainring for 1x road and gravel. X-AERORING is a large aero chainring made for the Dura-Ace 9200 crank.
크랭크 모델에 따라 맞는 볼트 수와 BCD가 다릅니다. 체인링 볼트(X-: The bolt count and BCD that fit depend on the crank model. Choose chainring bolts (X-FIX) and the crank cover (X-COVER DA9200) from the service parts. If you are unsure about compatibility, tell us your crank model and Rubi Workshop will find the right fitment.
Steel where it brakes,
carbon where it carries.
X-ROTOR STEELCARBON 3는 패드가 닿는 바깥 링은 스틸로,: X-ROTOR STEELCARBON 3 is a hybrid disc rotor with a steel outer ring where the pads bite and a carbon carrier joining it to the hub. It keeps the metal that braking needs and takes out spinning weight.
X-ROTOR AERO refines the same idea for racing. Both Center Lock and 6 bolt mounts are available, along with X-AFS versions, adapters, lock rings and a titanium bolt kit sold separately.
스틸 제동면과 카본 캐리어를 결합한 세 번째 세대 STEELCARBON: The third-generation STEELCARBON rotor, joining a steel braking surface to a carbon carrier. 140, 160 and 180mm for road and gravel.
레이스를 위해 형상을 다듬은 X-ROTOR입니다. 140 · 160mm,: The X-ROTOR shaped for racing. 140 and 160mm, in Center Lock, 6 bolt and X-AFS versions.
Right down to the small parts
that join frame and wheel.
X-LOCK EVO는 12mm 스루액슬입니다. 피치 1.0 · 1.5 ·: X-LOCK EVO is a 12mm thru axle, offered in 1.0, 1.5 and 1.75 pitch plus a Colnago-specific version, in frame-specific lengths and eight anodized colours.
스티어러 위의 X-CAP 탑캡과 X-PLUG 익스팬더, 시트포스트를 잡는: From the X-CAP top cap and X-PLUG expander on the steerer to the X-CLAMP 3 holding the seatpost. Small parts all over the frame, remade in carbon, titanium and precision-machined aluminium.
카본, 카본 매트, 티타늄 탑캡. 1-1/8과 1-1/4(OS) 스티어러: Carbon, matt carbon and titanium top caps for 1-1/8 and 1-1/4 (OS) steerers. Logo Torx bolts are available separately.
카본 스티어러용 익스팬더 플러그. 표준과 OS(1-1/4) 두 가지 규격: Expander plug for carbon steerers, in standard and OS (1-1/4) sizes.
경량 시트 클램프. 30.0mm부터 38.0mm까지 여섯 가지 지름, 여: Lightweight seat clamp in six diameters from 30.0mm to 38.0mm and eight colours.
스루액슬은 프레임과 포크마다 피치와 길이가 다릅니다. 지금 쓰는 액슬에: Thru axle pitch and length differ from frame to frame and fork to fork. Check the spec printed on your current axle, or tell us your frame model and we will find the right X-LOCK EVO.

UDH 행어와 볼트, 체인링 볼트, 로터 어댑터와 락링, 보틀케이지 볼트: UDH hangers and bolts, chainring bolts, rotor adapters and lock rings, bottle cage bolts. Even the parts you rarely notice are made to the same material and machining standard. Replacement parts are stocked in Korea, ready when you need them.
